recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-53981; maintainers can refresh checked-in diagrams through the normal generation process if they want the SVG labels to catch up.
issue_request: FHIR-53981 was an Applied FHIR-core Goal change request resolved as Persuasive with Modification. It asked to disambiguate Goal.statusDate and Goal.statusReason, with the final resolution renaming statusReason to lifecycleStatusReason, renaming statusDate to achievementStatusDate with the achievement spelling fixed, and moving each renamed element next to the status element it qualifies.
initial_application: Commit 7c5f0e11de0dc83a215b666f3d8f0ae8a563300b appears to be the prior application: it renamed and reordered the Goal elements in source/goal/structuredefinition-Goal.xml, updated source/goal/goal-example.xml, and added the Goal ballot note. The Jira comment also linked f17eb111cc, but that commit only changed source/status-codes.xml and did not affect the Goal rename.
additional_context: Goal is active in source/fhir.ini. The current StructureDefinition has Goal.lifecycleStatusReason immediately after Goal.lifecycleStatus and Goal.achievementStatusDate immediately after Goal.achievementStatus, and the example uses the renamed elements. Exact old Goal element names remain only in source/goal/goal.svg, a generated-looking diagram, and in a commented-out invariant-test snippet. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community decision; the Confluence Patient Care minutes page references FHIR-53981 while the Jira snapshot contains the substantive recorded vote and rationale.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Per the run guardrail, the stale generated-looking SVG alone was not treated as a source-changing target when the authoritative XML source is already correct.

related_jiras.note: The same implementation commit also added the unknown code to Goal.lifecycleStatus, but that is a separate change family not decided here.
The same implementation commit also added a resource-pertainsToGoal note, but that is a separate change family not decided here.
